scope: General mechanical CAD pilot. Frozen numeric checks are narrower than full functional correctness. First versus selected revision is a within-run comparison, not a historical-engine A/B.

cases.prompt: Create a single solid mounting plate centered on the origin, overall X 80 mm, Y 50 mm, Z 6 mm. Four Z-axis through holes of diameter 5.5 mm at XY (-30,-15), (-30,15), (30,-15), (30,15) mm. Round the four exterior vertical corners to R4. Use editable named float PARAMS. Deliver general mechanical CAD.

Create one solid flanged tube aligned along Z. A circular base flange diameter 60 mm, thickness 5 mm at Z=0..5. The concentric tube extends to Z=40, outside diameter 30 mm. A straight central diameter 20 mm Z-axis bore goes through the complete part. Three diameter 4 mm Z-axis mounting bores in the flange on a radius 24 mm circle at angles 0,120,240 degrees. Keep flange faces flat. Named float PARAMS, editable general mechanical CAD.

Create a one-piece L bracket, overall X=60, Y=40, Z=40 mm. Base occupies X=-30..30, Y=-20..20, Z=0..5. Upright along the back edge occupies Y=15..20 and extends to Z=40. Base has two Z-axis diameter 6 mm bores centered at XY (-20,-8) and (20,-8). Upright has a centered capsule slot, length 20 mm along X, width 6 mm along Z, centered at X=0 Z=25, cut through Y. Keep all geometry inside the envelope. Editable named float PARAMS.

Create an open enclosure and a separate removable flat lid as a two-solid Compound in assembly position. Enclosure exterior X=70,Y=45,Z=25 mm, lower face Z=0; wall thickness 2.5 mm and bottom 3 mm, open top. Put a flat 70x45x3 mm lid above it at Z=27..30, a 2 mm inspection gap. The combined envelope must be X70 Y45 Z30 mm. Add a rectangular 12x6 mm connector opening centered in the front Y wall, opening center Z=12 mm. No screws or added solids. Named float PARAMS. Retain both solids in STEP.

Create one hollow smooth transition duct along Z. Bottom at Z=0 is a 60x40 mm rectangle with centered 54x34 mm opening. Top at Z=50 is a circle OD30 ID24 mm centered on the same axis. Loft the outer and inner profiles smoothly and subtract the inner all the way through, leaving open ends and nominal 3 mm profile wall. Keep envelope X60 Y40 Z50 mm; one connected solid. No flanges. Editable named float PARAMS. The loft is essential, do not replace it with a block.

Create a one-solid bearing pedestal with base X70 Y35 Z6 mm at Z0..6. A centered upright block X30 Y20 extends from Z6 to Z38. Cut a straight diameter 16 mm bearing bore along Y at X=0 Z=24 completely through the upright. Two diameter 5 mm mounting bores along Z at XY(-25,0),(25,0). Overall envelope X70 Y35 Z38. Add two triangular supporting gussets between upright and base within the existing envelope, without obstructing any bore. Editable named float PARAMS.
